svg.title: The coherent conversion model’s damped transfer amplitude at coupling g is continuous on [0, G], equals zero at g = 0 and equals √η at g = G. Since x, y ≤η, both required couplings exist by the intermediate-value theorem. The coupling is fixed before the unknown input, uses no actual-sign feedback, has ∥C∥≤G, and hence has cross-subspace Hamiltonian norm at most ħG.
